data.name: Markazun
data.gender_notes: Markazun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Markazun is a name derived from the Arabic word 'markaz' which means 'center' or 'focus'. It is often used to describe someone who is at the heart of things, or who holds a position of importance and leadership. The name Markazun carries the meaning “Center, focus” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Markazun usually hope their child will grow to embody center, focus and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Markazun represents the idea of being at the center of one's spiritual journey, with a focus on inner growth and self-awareness. It is a name that encourages introspection and a deep connection with the divine.
data.etymology: Markazun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Center, focus.”

in_arabic.name: مركزون
in_arabic.meaning: المركزون: الاسم الذكوري الإسلامي يعني المركز، المكان، أو الموقعة
in_arabic.long_meaning: المركزون: الاسم الذكوري الإسلامي المركزي و هو من أسماء الله الحسنى، المركزون يطلق عليه أيضاً اسم المركز، المكان، الموقعة، والمسند، والمستند، والمرجع، و هو من أسماء الخلق، و هو اسم جيد، و يرمز إلى المركزية، و هو اسم مشروع، و يرمز إلى المكانة، و هو اسم ذو أهمية، و هو يرمز إلى المسند
